text: As I pass through glass doors into this world of bright colors and hard edges, I am reminded of how thresholds separate states of being. The clean, minimalism of the space outside contrasts sharply with the vibrant, informative wall ahead, inviting inquiry and curiosity. I feel as if I have entered a temple of knowledge, where innovation is venerated. The world here is precise yet bursting with the will to create. I feel a sense of potential and anticipation in this place.
